text: Sell RGTI — revenue is shrinking 34%, the company is deeply unprofitable, short interest is high, and the stock is down 20%; this is the weakest name in your portfolio with no fundamental support.
Sell RDW — it's down 21% with negative earnings, negative free cash flow, 18% short interest, and four straight earnings misses, which means the turnaround story isn't working.
Trim QBTS — no profits, negative free cash flow, and 15.5% short interest make this a high-risk speculative bet that deserves a smaller position size until the business proves itself.
Trim SKYT — a 70% gain at the 52-week high is great, but bearish MACD signals mean locking in some profit now protects you if the momentum fades.
Raise your stop on SGLP.L from 297.26 to 26,427.41 — this is your largest holding and locking in gains at this higher level protects a significant chunk of profit.
Add to META — a PE of just 17 with 22% revenue growth and strong free cash flow makes this arguably the best value in big tech right now.
Add to MSFT — 15% revenue growth, strong free cash flow, and consistent earnings beats make Microsoft a reliable core holding worth building up.
Add to LMT — Lockheed Martin's PE of 16, positive revenue growth, and steady defense spending tailwinds make it a solid value play in an uncertain market.
